    Splitting idempotents #

    • An idempotent on B ⊞ Z with vanishing component B ⟶ Z splits as soon as idempotents on B and on Z split: its diagonal blocks are idempotents, and their splittings combine with the off-diagonal component into a splitting.
    • An idempotent square matrix over a field factors as E * I with I * E = 1, through the range of the corresponding linear map.
